cues: Chloro, bromo and iodobenzene are colourless, sweet smelling, poisonous liquids.
All are denser than water and insoluble in it, but dissolve in organic solvents.
Boiling points rise from chloro to iodo, as the molecule gets bigger and more polarisable.
They are steam volatile, which is how chlorobenzene is separated in the laboratory.
